pages.title: GlassChat — Community chat, calmly
pages.description: GlassChat is an independent desktop text-chat Beta with a Liquid Glass-inspired interface. Explore the current features, verified limits and roadmap.

pages.title: GlassChat Downloads — Windows Beta releases
pages.description: See published GlassChat Windows releases, version details, release notes and SHA-256 checksums. No download is offered before a real release is published.

pages.title: GlassChat Documentation — Setup and current features
pages.description: Read GlassChat setup guidance, account and channel instructions, current Beta limitations, privacy notes and troubleshooting information.

pages.title: GlassChat Roadmap — Current progress and next steps
pages.description: Follow GlassChat development progress, security and release gates, and clearly marked ideas for future community, messaging and voice features.

pages.title: GlassChat Changelog — Version and build history
pages.description: Read verified GlassChat build notes, semantic versions and release status. Development candidates are kept separate from published releases.

pages.title: GlassChat Support — Help and bug reporting
pages.description: Find GlassChat setup guidance, contact the project operator, and report ordinary bugs or security issues through the appropriate channel.

pages.title: GlassChat Community — Official links and status
pages.description: Find the official GlassChat community status. No community invitation or social accounts have been published yet.

pages.title: GlassChat Security — Privacy status and reporting
pages.description: Review GlassChat's implemented security boundaries and known Beta limitations, and find responsible vulnerability-reporting guidance.

pages.title: GlassChat Privacy Policy — Working draft for review
pages.description: Read the GlassChat privacy-policy working draft, known account and message data, provider status, storage limits and operator contact.

pages.title: GlassChat Terms of Service — Working draft
pages.description: Review the GlassChat terms-of-service working draft, Beta status, account limits and legal provisions that still need operator and counsel review.

pages.title: GlassChat Community Guidelines — Working draft
pages.description: Read proposed GlassChat community conduct principles and the current limits of moderation, reports and appeals in the Beta.

pages.title: GlassChat Acceptable Use Policy — Working draft
pages.description: Review proposed acceptable-use boundaries for GlassChat and the current limits of enforcement and safety features.

pages.title: GlassChat Cookie & Local Storage — Working draft
pages.description: Read how the GlassChat website, email-action pages and desktop client currently use cookies, local storage and session material.

pages.title: GlassChat Email Verification — Account action
pages.description: Confirm a GlassChat email address using a one-time token. This page is not indexed and only submits after the user confirms.

pages.title: GlassChat Password Reset — Account action
pages.description: Set a new GlassChat password with a one-time reset token. This page is not indexed and requires an explicit form submission.
